diagnostics.message: module.eks_blueprints.module.emr_on_eks:resource.null_resource.update_trust_policy: explicit depends_on of module.eks_blueprints.module.emr_on_eks:resource.aws_iam_role.emr_on_eks_execution is redundant — already implied by attribute references

module.eks_blueprints.module.emr_on_eks:resource.null_resource.update_trust_policy: explicit depends_on of module.eks_blueprints.module.emr_on_eks:resource.kubernetes_namespace.spark is redundant — already implied by attribute references

module.eks_blueprints.module.aws_eks_managed_node_groups:resource.aws_eks_node_group.managed_ng: explicit depends_on of module.eks_blueprints.module.aws_eks_managed_node_groups:resource.aws_iam_role.managed_ng is redundant — already implied by attribute references

module.eks_blueprints.module.aws_eks_self_managed_node_groups:resource.aws_autoscaling_group.self_managed_ng: explicit depends_on of module.eks_blueprints.module.aws_eks_self_managed_node_groups:resource.aws_iam_instance_profile.self_managed_ng is redundant — already implied by attribute references

module.eks_blueprints.module.aws_eks_self_managed_node_groups:resource.aws_autoscaling_group.self_managed_ng: explicit depends_on of module.eks_blueprints.module.aws_eks_self_managed_node_groups:resource.aws_iam_role.self_managed_ng is redundant — already implied by attribute references

`aws_eks_node_group.managed_ng` already references `aws_iam_role.managed_ng[0].arn` through `node_role_arn`, which establishes the ordering implicitly. The explicit `depends_on = [aws_iam_role.managed_ng, ...]` entry is therefore redundant.

`null_resource.update_trust_policy`'s local-exec command interpolates `${aws_iam_role.emr_on_eks_execution.id}`, so the dependency is already implied. The explicit `depends_on` on `aws_iam_role.emr_on_eks_execution` is redundant.

`null_resource.update_trust_policy`'s local-exec command interpolates `${kubernetes_namespace.spark.id}`, so the dependency is already implied. The explicit `depends_on` on `kubernetes_namespace.spark` is redundant.

The `gp3` StorageClass uses provisioner `ebs.csi.aws.com`, which is registered by the AWS EBS CSI driver installed via `module.eks_blueprints_kubernetes_addons` (`enable_self_managed_aws_ebs_csi_driver = true`). It has no expressed dependency on that module, so Terraform may create the StorageClass before the provisioner exists. It should depend on `module.eks_blueprints_kubernetes_addons`.

The `efs` StorageClass uses provisioner `efs.csi.aws.com`, which is registered by the AWS EFS CSI driver installed via `module.eks_blueprints_kubernetes_addons` (`enable_aws_efs_csi_driver = true`). While it references `module.efs.id`, it has no dependency on the CSI driver addon, so it may be created before the provisioner is available. It should also depend on `module.eks_blueprints_kubernetes_addons`.
